chunks: And by this chain, he said:
I asked him عليه السلام about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
“Except one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.”
He عليه السلام said: “The sound heart is that by which one meets his Lord while there is no one in it besides Him.”
He عليه السلام said: “And every heart in which there is shirk or doubt is fallen. They only intended zuhd in the world so that their hearts might be emptied for the Hereafter.”

key_terms.الزُّهْدَ فِي الدُّنْيَا: detachment from worldly life out of spiritual discipline
key_terms.الْقَلْبُ السَّلِيمُ: the heart that is wholly devoted to Allah
key_terms.بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ: with a sound and spiritually pure heart
key_terms.شَكٌّ: doubt that corrupts certainty and sincerity
key_terms.شِرْكٌ: associating partners with Allah in belief or inward devotion
key_terms.لِلْآخِرَةِ: for the sake of the Hereafter

ai.seo_question: What does “a sound heart” mean in Qur'an 26:89 according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase “a sound heart” as a heart devoted purely to Allah, with no attachment of shirk or doubt within it. It also shows that zuhd toward the world is sought so that the heart may be freed for the Hereafter and remain sincere before Allah.
